title: A commuter pass
bodyMd: A rail operator replaced a ten-trip ticket with a monthly pass. The average revenue per pass buyer fell, but the number of buyers increased. The operator reported higher total pass revenue. A newspaper inferred that the railway had also gained passengers overall. The operator cautioned that some new pass buyers had previously bought single tickets; its report covered pass sales only, and had not counted all journeys or all fare revenue.
